canonical_project.name: F-codex
canonical_project.role: structural evidence index for the Global Experience Agent

automatic_indexing.explicit_c_drive_rule: Only inspect or index a narrowly named C-drive path when the current task states why host implementation evidence is necessary; use a temporary task-scoped project name, record the path and expiry, and delete the derived project before returning to the single-project F-codex gate.

callable_discovery.rule: before treating codebase-memory-mcp as unavailable, query the current task callable capability registry for deferred or namespaced tools
callable_discovery.fallback: if not callable, record the gap and use local file, Git, and lifecycle evidence without graph-based claims

allowed_operations.name: get_code_snippet
allowed_operations.precondition: search_graph or another graph query has identified the exact qualified_name

agent_use_lifecycle.action: refresh F-codex with index_repository when callable
read schema and architecture for structure, labels, edges, clusters, hotspots, and visible exclusions
select the smallest owner and file surface using graph evidence
open cited source files before behavior, owner, absence, or mutation claims
write graph coverage and source verification into the Agent save point or final evidence

authority_boundary.human: may request graph-backed orientation and reports through registered Agent operations
authority_boundary.llm: may use graph evidence for routing and source targeting under current task authority
authority_boundary.internal-functional-unit: may consume graph evidence as an input but cannot directly mutate Agent structure
authority_boundary.global-control: may route structure-affecting changes through codex-architecture-iteration and the agent_structure gate
never_allowed: treating graph misses as absence proof without source verification
using graph evidence to bypass owner tool gates
committing MCP databases or machine-specific MCP configuration
indexing external reference repositories into the global cache for single-project validation
automatically indexing Codex installation, Codex home, Agent home, or other C-drive system paths

source_verification_rule: graph output routes attention; current source files and tests remain final proof
